runs.text: Israel fits in here five hundred and ninety three times. First, Israel at true size: twenty two thousand and seventy two square kilometres. The West Bank and Gaza are shaded. Not counted. Pick it up, and drop it on Jordan. Jordan holds four Israels. Syria, just over eight. Now it gets bigger. Egypt? One. Two. Three. Egypt holds forty five Israels. Saudi Arabia? About one hundred. A hundred Israels in one country. Now the whole Arab League, from Morocco to Oman. five hundred and ninety three Israels. Every copy at true size. Size isn't everything. But it explains why every kilometre here matters. Which country should I drop Israel on next? Count it again.
